note: Use ASEAN countries from 2010-2023 only. The WDI file also contains 2024-2025, but should be excluded for this thesis period.

combined_dataset.xlsx appears to have numeric-format/scaling issues in many percentage and exchange-rate columns. Use wdi data.xlsx for WDI variables, or re-import/clean combined_dataset before estimation.
Use unbalanced panel, because broad money/trade/interest variables are missing for Laos and Myanmar in several years.
Start with pooled OLS, then Fixed Effects (country FE and year FE). Use Hausman test to compare FE vs RE; use robust/clustered standard errors by country.
Do not put ir_deposit, ir_real, and ir_lending together in the same main regression. Use one interest-rate proxy per model.
Use ln_gdppc = ln(gdppc); xr_dep = 100*(ln(xr_official_it)-ln(xr_official_i,t-1)); optionally ln_tourism and ln_pop.
Main model: fdi_gdp on bm_gdp, ir_deposit, inflation, trade openness, ln_gdppc, and exchange-rate depreciation with country and year fixed effects.
